note: Docker parity for one Linux host. Each row says what anode does today, not what it plans. Sources are the unit template (internal/deployer/systemd.go) and docs/supported-profile.md.

rows.docker: HEALTHCHECK, checked on a schedule; unhealthy containers are visible to the engine
rows.anode: GET /healthz must return 200 to 399 at deploy, or the deploy stops. No ongoing health check: a process that is up but unhealthy stays up.
Restart=always, RestartSec=3, no start limit. Retries forever at 3 s.
CPUQuota=200% and MemoryMax=1G in the template. Not configurable per service today.

rows.docker: env files, Docker secrets, or a secret store
rows.anode: .env on the developer machine, written to a 0600 env file or a root-only config file on the host. No secret store.
One StateDirectory per service, owned by its dynamic user. No arbitrary bind mounts.

rows.docker: docker logs, json-file or other drivers
rows.anode: journald through systemd. anode logs reads them.
No equivalent command. Use ssh and systemctl or journalctl.

rows.docker: SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after the stop timeout
rows.anode: The unit sends SIGTERM and waits 10 s (TimeoutStopSec). Caddy holds requests up to 5 s while the unit restarts. The service must drain on SIGTERM itself; the orders example does. Local test: 0 failed requests with the change vs 118,047 without it (benchmarks/2026-11-18/sigterm-drain). Not yet tested on a remote host.

rows.docker: Varies: a reverse proxy you add yourself
rows.anode: Caddy in front, automatic certificates for a domain. --plain-http for testing.
Services bind to per-service ports (21040 and up). Ports are dropped on external interfaces by iptables. No service DNS; connections are set in the lockfile.

rows.docker: Fixed host ports collide when two copies run
rows.anode: anode dev assigns dynamic loopback ports. Measured: 10 of 10 copies started. Per-copy stores are not isolated yet.

rows.docker: Dockerfile builds an image; registry push and pull
rows.anode: No image. Cross-compiles a static Linux binary with CGO_ENABLED=0 and uploads it.

rows.docker: Varies by orchestrator; Compose recreates containers
rows.anode: Restarts every unit of the project. Lockfile-diff deploys that restart only changed units are not built.
anode rollback switches each unit back to the previous release, verified by release hash.
Native Redis, PostgreSQL in containers or external. Other kinds run in containers, and only PostgreSQL is tested for deploy.

rows.docker: Swarm, Kubernetes, or Compose over SSH
rows.anode: anode cluster exists. No benchmark or failure test in the repository.
anode ps and status read cgroup v2 memory per unit.
